newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S. Korea LG-Caltex exports mogas to US West Coast.
newsitem.headline: S. Korea LG-Caltex exports mogas to US West Coast.

text.p: South Korea's LG-Caltex Oil Corp said on Monday it has sold 240,000 barrels of gasoline to U.S.-based Marubeni International Energy Corp, a subsidiary of Japan's Marubeni Corp.
The refiner said in a statement this marked the first gasoline export deal to the United States from a Northeast Asian refiner.
The near 93-RON unleaded gasoline was sold at $28 per barrel free-on-board South Korea, it said.
The shipment left LG-Caltex's refinery at Yeochon over the weekend and was scheduled to arrive at Seattle in the U.S. and Vancouver, Canada, between March 15-20.
Traders said they were not surprised at the deal into the U.S. west coast as South Korea's current refining capacity exceeds domestic demand so the refiners have been looking for sales outlets.
South Korea's refining capacity rose to 2.4 million bpd in 1996 from 1.8 at the end of 1995 resulting in a surplus capacity of 230,000 bpd, analysts said.
South Korean refiners have also been noted participants in monthly reformate buying tenders from Taiwan this year.
